Subagent orchestration gate
Result: use-subagent-orchestrator
Reason: Strong orchestration signals detected.
Action: Production contract: invoke the subagent-orchestrator skill before broad work; choose single-thread, sequential-plan, or parallel-subagents; if parallel-subagents is selected and tool policy permits, emit a compact why-parallel proof, define bounded roles, spawn the smallest useful bounded read-only roster, wait, then synthesize before edits; if spawning is unavailable or blocked, state the blocker and continue with the closest safe fallback.

Why parallel:
- independent track 1: map SKILL.md, hook output, classifier labels, and agent templates with file evidence
- independent track 2: review over-spawn and under-spawn risks against conservative safety rules
- independent track 3: identify eval/test gaps for auto-orchestration handoff
Blockers checked: explicit user opt-out, child-agent recursion, strict sequential dependencies, conflicting writes, workspace-write dirty-state isolation, external side effects, privacy/tool limits, unbounded broad agent tasks.
Read-only agents must report whether findings depend on uncommitted changes.
Subagents:
- so_mapper
  mode: read-only
  scope: orchestration trigger docs, hook output, classifier labels, and agent templates
  expected output: files, facts, uncertainty, and likely change boundaries
  constraints: no recursive fan-out
- so_reviewer
  mode: read-only
  scope: over-spawn risks, under-spawn risks, and safety-rule conflicts
  expected output: material risks and recommended next action
  constraints: no recursive fan-out
- so_tester
  mode: read-only
  scope: hook and skill eval coverage for auto-orchestration handoff
  expected output: regression cases, commands, and coverage gaps
  constraints: no recursive fan-out
